# Will a climbing gym make money? Monthly profit, payback and break-even members

> Free calculator for climbing and bouldering gyms. Enter day passes, memberships, youth programs, parties, staff, route setting, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even members and the lowest day pass and membership fee for your target margin. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
